query_referencia: SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(seq_dat_pagamento AS VARCHAR), 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS mes, SUM(CAST(vlr_rmn_liquida AS DECIMAL)) AS total FROM remuneracao_municipio WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes;
query_gerada: SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(r.seq_dat_pagamento AS VARCHAR), 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS mes, SUM(CAST(r.vlr_rmn_liquida AS DECIMAL)) AS total_folha FROM remuneracao_municipio r WHERE r.ano_referencia = 2025 AND r.dsc_sit_serv_pens ILIKE '%Ativo%' GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes;
